svg.title: Confidence that a dark spell is more than missed detections, by clear dark nights
svg.text: Confidence that a dark spell is more than missed detections
Tested against a model in which the flare kept burning at its usual heat; misses allowed to cluster
clear nights in a row with no flare seen
High: 90% or more across the fleet
clear misses in a row if the
Misses cluster: after a clear miss, the next clear night was also a miss 13 of 50 times (26%); the model uses 59%.
Not measured: whether gas still flows, or a flame below about 0.2–0.3 MW (Figure 23).
